155K likes, 708 comments - boydbrown3 on July 29, 2026: "Everyone wants to lose weight until they find out it still takes effort in the kitchen. These cabbage dumplings make that part a whole lot easier. 🥟🥟🔥

Cabbage Dumplings

Ingredients

Ground chicken, 2 pounds
Portabella mushrooms, finely diced, 8 ounces
Scallions, finely sliced, 4
Soy sauce, 2 tablespoons
Oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon
Chicken bouillon powder, 1 teaspoon
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Small Napa cabbage, 1 to 2 heads
Furikake, for garnish
Chili oil, for serving
Sliced scallions, for garnish

Instructions

Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blanch the Napa cabbage leaves for 45 seconds to 1 minute, just until softened and flexible. Transfer to a towel and pat dry.

In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken bouillon, salt, and pepper. Mix until everything is well combined.

Spoon the filling onto the base of each cabbage leaf. Fold in the sides and roll tightly to seal.

Arrange the dumplings seam side down in a large skillet or steamer. Add 1/4 cup water to the pan, cover, and steam over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees.

Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate for 1 to 2 minutes.

Finish with furikake, a drizzle of chili oil, and sliced scallions before serving.

#dumplings #cabbage #healthyeating #food #foodstagram".

audio.transcript: Losing weight does not mean eating bland food. These ground chicken and cabbage dumplings are worth eating every day and still keep you on track. Dice up some scallions, then dice up a few mushrooms until they turn into crumbs. We're gonna blanch our Napa cabbage for 45 seconds. Anything more would be uncivilized. Tossing your ground chicken, mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken powder, and salt and pepper. Get your hands dirty and mix until incorporated. Add a spoonful of filling near the bottom of the cabbage leaf, fold in the sides as needed and just roll, baby, nice and tight. Add them into a skillet, pouring a little water for moisture, and about 15 minutes later, add some chili oil, some very coke, then serve. Man, Picasso. Follow me for more.
